source_grounded_findings.statement: The reviewed model-facing transcript is the DataAgent messages list, initialized from the query and database description, extended with assistant tool-call messages and tool-role results carrying matching tool_call_id values. The only reviewed G11 behavioural injection point is a user-role message appended before call_llm.
source_grounded_findings.not_established: Real provider acceptance and response-boundary behavior.

source_grounded_findings.statement: The reviewed ledger exposes a frozen action/reason/target-status state through RecordAssessment and NextAction, but the reviewed runtime renders only the fixed generic GUIDANCE_TEMPLATE. It does not expose the selected action, target, or status.

A task-agnostic structured directive can be passed at the same call_llm boundary with action, reason, record status, opaque target token, target scope, target status, category, freshness, and compact inventory counts using an allow-list of structural fields and no task/db/plan/step/ref/tool/answer content.
source_grounded_findings.not_established: Real-model reading or compliance; provider acceptance.

source_grounded_findings.statement: The same-state generic control preserves the reviewed ledger state, dispatch sequence, argument-key sets, active view, guidance count, and cap/deadline behavior. The exact reviewed generic template does not carry the selected action, target, or target status; a length-matched generic variant also does not.

A programmed synthetic policy reads the structured action and chooses different synthetic next steps for absent (query_db) and unknown (return_answer_preserve_unknown), while a generic-keyword policy chooses query_db in both cases. This demonstrates only that the interface is information-bearing to a programmed policy.
source_grounded_findings.not_established: Real-model compliance, provider acceptance, task relevance, correctness, or benefit.

source_grounded_findings.statement: The reviewed ledger re-evaluates the active plan only on submit_record; new observations do not automatically update the active assessment. The prototype marks the active state stale after later observations and preserves the old directive and target status until an accepted revision updates it.
source_grounded_findings.not_established: Automatic freshness update or semantic resolution.

source_grounded_findings.statement: Because the reviewed adapter captures the record before dispatching the record-carrying call and records the observation after dispatch, the record-carrying call's own observation is counted as the first post-assessment observation. stale_new_observations therefore does not by itself prove an independent new observation.

Model-authored refs can be separated from a runtime structural inventory of provenance-valid, evidence-bearing, successful, non-truncated action observations. Unreferenced eligible observations are structural counts, not semantic obligations; omission is not determined without task content.
source_grounded_findings.not_established: Independent semantic obligation derivation or omitted-obligation detection.

source_grounded_findings.statement: Frozen status/reason pairs can be separated into evidence-gap, instrumentation-loss, response-boundary-gap, and authoring/lifecycle-gap categories without semantic promotion. The same failed status splits by reason: provenance is instrumentation loss, while tool failure and non-evidence source are evidence gaps.
source_grounded_findings.not_established: Semantic meaning, relevance, or correctness of any category.

source_grounded_findings.statement: The frozen invalid-ref status exists in _resolve_ref, but the formal parser rejects an invalid ref token as a malformed record before resolution, so invalid is not reachable through a valid authored record in this path.
source_grounded_findings.not_established: Any semantic interpretation of invalid refs.

source_grounded_findings.statement: A same-response record referencing an earlier call in that response resolves as late; a record referencing its own call resolves as pre_entry; a next-response record referencing the prior call resolves as unique/proceed. A terminal return_answer in the same response leaves an active non-proceed assessment but produces zero guidance because the loop ends before another call_llm boundary.
source_grounded_findings.not_established: Mid-response intervention or later-turn guidance when no later turn occurs.

source_grounded_findings.statement: The reviewed active source uses active_assessment and therefore does not surface a rejected malformed or stale attempt when no active accepted record exists; it can instead re-emit guidance for an older active state. The prototype latest_attempt source surfaces the latest rejected attempt as revise_plan with its record status.
source_grounded_findings.not_established: Which source mode a real model or formal experiment should use.

source_grounded_findings.statement: The prototype message and G11 sidecar/summary pass synthetic privacy checks: no task, database, plan, step, ref, or answer secrets appear; the plan record is removed before base dispatch; the standalone record tool persists only a redaction marker. The base DataAgent raw-context logs remain a separate unerased surface.
source_grounded_findings.not_established: A no-leak audit of existing raw-context logs.

source_grounded_findings.statement: The prototype preserves the reviewed caps: three guidance messages, one per turn, three extra model turns, three extra dispatches, zero mechanism-initiated tool calls, a fail-closed 180-second guard, and no wall-time extension. Structured, generic, and disabled interface modes have identical dispatch sequences for the same scripted calls.
source_grounded_findings.not_established: Real-run budget behavior, timeout effects, or forced-answer behavior.
